## Governance checklist (mandatory)

- [ ] No employer-facing score, ranking, pass/fail, or auto-reject behaviour introduced
- [ ] No new personal-data collection without an updated Data Use Register entry
- [ ] Integrity signals remain separated from capability evidence
- [ ] Human-oversight guardrails (disclosure-before-start, finalised-review-before-report) untouched or strengthened
- [ ] Audit events added for material new actions

## Quality checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes; new logic has tests
- [ ] Migrations are additive (no edits to merged migrations)
- [ ] Error paths return the standard error contract
- [ ] Docs / ADRs updated where behaviour or architecture changed
